name: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Hahaha... you need Nitromirglyceronium to stop goblins from destroying a forest?!

I don't care if you know Gaxim or not... I'll give you the stuff just to see you or them explode into itty bitty pieces.

There's a problem though: I'm all out.

But I'll tell you what, you bring me the correct potions, and I'll make some up for you right away.

The least you can do is prove you've got some skill as an alchemist before I just give you a sample of my greatest creation.
narrative.objectives: Bring 4 Minor Mana Potions and 2 Elixirs of Minor Fortitude to Lomac Gearstrip in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
This'll do nicely.

If I didn't know better, stranger, I'd say you knew somethin' about alchemy. Good, good... the world's not all about swords and sorcery, you know?
narrative.requestItemsText: I can't make any Nitromirglyceronium if I don't have the potions... they're vital to its creation.
